verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions inside Cake itself. The documented AI capability is a read-only MCP connection that lets external assistants (Claude, Codex, Cursor) answer cap-table questions. That is an AI-client integration belonging to a different story, not in-product AI. The dashboard's Actions list and vesting-event count are standard non-AI features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
